content.title: INDYCAR Live Updates, Leaderboard: Grand Prix of Long Beach Highlights
content.text: Alex Palou took home the Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach, winning gthe second-biggest event on the NTT INDYCAR circuit behind the Indy 500. After a caution on Lap 58, Palou took advantage of his preferred pit position, beating Felix Rosenqvist out of pit lane to take the lead of the race. Rosenqvist, who started on pole, finished in second, while Palou earned his third victory of the 2026 season. Live Coverage for this has ended Apr 19, 2026 - 7:19p ET Alex Palou Takes the Lead Out of Pit Row Using his preferred pit position to his advantage, Alex Palou pulled out of his pit stop just ahead of Felix Rosenqvist to take the lead of the race. Apr 19, 2026 - 7:19p ET Will Power Receives Penalty Will Power received a penalty after contacting a crew member in pit lane when he came in for a pit stop during the caution flag. Apr 19, 2026 - 7:13p ET Caution on Lap 58 We have our first caution at the Grand Prix of Long Beach as there was debris on the track. It resets the gaps and brings Felix Rosenqvist back closer to the field for the final third of the race. It benefits drivers such as David Malukas in fourth and Josef Newgarden in the midfield.Apr 19, 2026 - 6:45p ET Felix Rosenqvist Retakes the Lead Felix Rosenqvist retook the lead of the Grand Prix of Long Beach after Josef Newgarden headed to the pits. Newgarden fell back to 14th, but is now on fresh tires and has a lighter car than those ahead of him. It'll be up to Newgarden to navigate traffic and return to the top of the field.Apr 19, 2026 - 6:39p ET Josef Newgarden Moves Into Lead Josef Newgarden took over the lead of the race after the leaders pit. He, and team Penske, put themselves into the competition by pitting early, and now have a chance to further establish themselves as Newgarden controls the tempo of the race. Apr 19, 2026 - 6:16p ET Josef Newgarden, Team Penske Take Risk Josef Newgarden and team Penske made the first huge strategy call of the race. Newgarden was one of the fastest drivers on track, but found himself stuck in traffic. So the team opted to have him pit, put soft tires on, and play to his speed. Newgarden could also greatly benefit from a caution in the near future. Apr 19, 2026 - 6:13p ET Alex Palou overtakes Pato O'Ward It didn't take long for the 2025 NTT INDYCAR SERIES champion to make a move. On the second lap of the race, Alex Palou overtook Pato O'Ward, and now sits in the mirror of race leader, Felix Rosenqvist.
